paper_metadata.title: Creep behavior of high-strength low-alloy steel at elevated temperatures

evidence.quote: In this paper experimental data about the creep behavior of high-strength low-alloy (HSLA, ASTM A618) steel are presented.

The material under consideration is high-strength low-alloy steel (HSLA) ASTM A618 with the following composition Wt (%): Fe (98.6384), C (0.1959), Si (0.1942), S (0.0037), Mn (0.5508), P (0.0131), Ni (0.1147), Mo (0.0106), Cr (0.0645).
